name: Catalog
description: Example JS plugin (CMS 2.1.0): a product catalogue — a Products content type with price, gallery, related products and a specs table, Product categories (hierarchical) and Brands taxonomies with archive pages, a JSON import, and a product feed for headless clients protected by an API key stored as a secret setting.
author: Anasaki Studio

label.th: API key ของฟีดสินค้า

help.th: ส่งใน header X-Api-Key เพื่ออ่าน /catalog/feed.json — เว้นว่าง = ปิดฟีด
help.en: Send it as the X-Api-Key header to read /catalog/feed.json; empty = no feed
